## What's new

- A new UI Theme, ChaOS Pixel Names (MENU > UI Theme): each console is its
  name in the ChaOS logo's pixel letters, the last word in the console's
  colour, with the logo's loose pixels beside it.
- As you scroll, the name you land on flies together pixel by pixel and
  the one you leave breaks apart again. Favorites and Muse too.

---

ChaOS 0.10.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.10.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.10.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
